description: Held piece at the end of each pick-cube episode: pin (perno/tornillo) or nopin. Labelled by visual inspection of the last frame of both cameras (Claude, 2026-10-24; sessions of 2026-10-24 08:45 onward labelled the same day after the snapshots showed what a pin looks like); 'moderate' = judged from a blurred or partial view, 'unsure'/'exclude' are not used for training. Sessions from 2026-10-24 12:58 onward (192 episodes) labelled the same way on 2026-10-25 from contact sheets of both last frames (Claude); 'moderate' is common because the pin is often hidden on the underside.
